rule: a pick needs an actionable sportsbook price (DraftKings via ESPN, fresh, pre-start)
best_bets_rule: a best bet needs a real sportsbook price; model-only projections, PrizePicks and parlays are excluded. DraftKings props (paid Odds API) need a fresh pre-start quote and calibrated EV >= +2% at that price
method_note: Unified view of every curated pick board, BOOK-PRICED picks only: each pick carries its DraftKings price and observed time, and the edge is EV at that price. Model-only projections, PrizePicks and parlays are excluded. Each pick is filed under its highest-conviction category and de-duped across boards. Empty when nothing is priced.
